enumDescriptions.AlertOnly: The policy service is operating in alert only mode.
enumDescriptions.Enabled: The policy service is fully enabled.

enumLongDescriptions.AlertOnly: This value shall indicate that the policy service is operating in alert only mode and shall only perform responses of type `Event` or `Recheck`.  The underlying service implementation may still perform some actions as determined by the manufacturer, such as throttling on thermal events, in order to preserve the system.
enumLongDescriptions.Disabled: This value shall indicate that the policy service is disabled and shall take no automatic action.  The underlying service implementation may still perform some actions as determined by the manufacturer, such as throttling on thermal events, in order to preserve the system.
enumLongDescriptions.Enabled: This value shall indicate that the policy service is operating in autonomous mode where it performs all responses.
